segments.name: Performance advertising
segments.description: Taboola operates an AI-powered performance advertising platform that places ads on publishers' digital properties for advertisers outside search and social media.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers, agencies, merchants and affiliate networks pay Taboola for clicks, purchases or impressions on ads shown on digital properties, with revenue generally shared with those publishers.
revenueModel.evidence: Advertisers pay Taboola for those clicks, purchases or impressions and Taboola generally shares the resulting revenue with the digital properties who display those ads.

changes.text: In 2025, Taboola launched Realize, a new performance advertising platform, expanding from native advertising to broader performance advertising.
changes.evidence: In February 2025, we announced the launch of Realize, our new performance advertising platform built to drive results at scale on digital publisher properties outside of search and social media platforms.
